name: Kenzen! Hentai Kouboku no Tsutome

source:
An abundance of [i]sex appeal[/i] is an indispensable trait for we humans, who inherited the genes of our ancestors with the promise that we will pass them down to our offspring.

[i]Nutrition, Sleep,[/i] and [b]SEX[/b]

These are the three necessities of human life. And in this world, there are those known as "[b]perverts[/b]," humans OVERFLOWING with [i]healthy levels[/i] of [b]sexual attractiveness[/b]. and who work hard to satisfy the [b]carnal appetites[/b] of both themselves and others.

[i]Copulation to Completion![/i]

Once [b]sexual intercourse[/b] has begun, it must continue until all parties are [b]satisfied[/b]. [b]Sex Officers[/b] working for the Office of Sexual Affairs live by these words.

[b]Sex Officers[/b] are civil servants who offer [b]sexual services[/b] to the public. Their existence is a cornerstone for the maintenance of societal order. Their services are an outlet for [b]sexual desire[/b], an outlet which recharges mind and body and prevents the build up of [b][i]SEXUAL FRUSTRATION[/i][/b]. The one absolute requirement for becoming a Sex Officer is that you must be a [b][i]PERVERT[/i][/b]

This story is a documentary focused on the office's community division, the department which deals the most with the public. Taking the viewpoint of a newly appointed [b]Sex Officer[/b], this is an exploration of an officer's [b]HONORABLE[/b] daily efforts to bring [b][i]sexual relief[/i][/b] to the public.
